recipes.name: Chicken Machboos
recipes.description: The UAE's everyday masterpiece: chicken and basmati rice cooked together with loomi, turmeric and baharat.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil; remove and soften onions with spices.
Add tomatoes, loomi and water; poach chicken 30 minutes; reserve broth.
Cook rice in the broth until just tender; do not over-stir.
Pile rice on a platter; top with chicken and a spoon of the cooking liquid.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Chicken Majboos Recipe | Arabic Rice Machboos | Arabian Chicken Dish by Nawab's Kitchen

recipes.name: Harees bil Dajaj
recipes.description: Wheat beaten with chicken into a velvet porridge - the dish that opens every Emirati Ramadan table.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken with aromatics until very tender; shred finely.
Add wheat to the strained broth; simmer low 2-3 hours, whisking often.
Beat until smooth porridge with shredded chicken throughout.
Finish with ghee, salt and white pepper; serve hot.

videos.videoTitle: Emirati Harees Recipe | Hareesa | الهريس الاماراتي | Arabic Chicken Harees Recipe | हरीस रेसिपी

recipes.name: Thareed Dajaj
recipes.description: Layers of thin regag bread soaked under a brothy lamb-style chicken-and-vegetable ragu.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; add tomato, spices, loomi and water; simmer 25 minutes.
Add vegetables; cook until everything is tender and brothy.
Line bowls with regag bread; ladle stew over to soak.
Top with coriander and serve immediately while bread is softening.

videos.videoTitle: Chicken Thareed | ثريد | Ramadan special by cook with areej

recipes.name: Emirati Chicken Biryani
recipes.description: Layered saffron rice and masala chicken reflecting generations of Emirati-South Asian exchange.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in spiced yogurt for at least 2 hours.
Parboil rice with whole spices until 70% done.
Cook chicken masala until thick; layer rice, masala, herbs and fried onions twice.
Seal with saffron milk and ghee; steam on lowest heat 35 minutes (dum).

recipes.name: Beef Machboos
recipes.description: Slow-simmered beef gives deeper, darker spice broth to this machboos variation.

steps.instruction: Sear beef; cook down onions and tomatoes with all spices.
Cover with water and simmer 80-90 minutes until fork-tender.
Boil rice in the broth until absorbed.
Serve beef atop rice with extra broth passed around.

recipes.name: Beef Harees
recipes.description: The classic wedding-feast version: wheat and slow-cooked beef beaten into silken porridge.

steps.instruction: Simmer beef with spices until falling apart; shred into its broth.
Add soaked wheat; cook low 3 hours whisking until silky.
Beat in ghee and season well.
Serve hot with extra ghee pools on top.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Beef Harees Arabic Recipe/Hraees Recipe//Meat Recipe

recipes.name: Madrouba bil Lahma
recipes.description: 'The beaten one' - rice and beef cooked together then whipped into a creamy savory risotto-like porridge.

steps.instruction: Brown beef with onion and spices; cover with water and simmer 70 minutes.
Add rice and enough broth; cook until very soft.
Beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until creamy and uniform.
Season and serve drizzled with ghee.

recipes.name: Beef Thareed
recipes.description: Thin regag bread soaked under slow-simmered beef and vegetable broth - prophetic-era comfort.

steps.instruction: Brown beef; add paste, spices, loomi and water; simmer 80 min.
Add vegetables; cook until tender and brothy.
Line bowls with bread; ladle stew over to soak.

recipes.name: Vegetable Saloona
recipes.description: Light everyday Emirati vegetable stew scented with loomi and coriander - the daily side that anchors rice.

steps.instruction: Fry coriander stems briefly; add tomatoes and bezr spices.
Add vegetables, chickpeas, loomi and stock; simmer 25 minutes.
Adjust to a light gravy consistency; season.

recipes.name: Chebab
recipes.description: Golden saffron-cardamom pancakes served with date syrup and cream cheese - Emirati breakfast joy.

steps.instruction: Whisk yogurt, eggs, sugar, saffron milk and cardamom.
Fold in flour and leaveners into a thick pourable batter.
Cook ladlefuls on a buttered griddle until bubbles pop; flip once.
Stack warm with cream cheese and plenty of date syrup.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Authentic Emirati Chebab | Easy Arabic Pancake Recipe with Saffron

recipes.name: Balaleet
recipes.description: Sweet saffron vermicelli topped with a soft omelette - the UAE's beloved sweet-savory breakfast.

steps.instruction: Toast dry vermicelli in butter until golden.
Add water to just cover; simmer until soft and liquid is gone.
Sweeten with sugar, cardamom, saffron and rose water.
Press into a flat layer; cover with a thin omelette before serving.

recipes.name: Chella (Regag Bread)
recipes.description: Egg-cheese batter cooked paper-thin on the domed regag griddle - old Dubai street breakfast.

steps.instruction: Knead soft elastic dough; rest 30 minutes.
Whisk eggs, onion, cheese, cumin and salt into chella batter.
Stretch a paper-thin sheet of dough onto an inverted hot wok (regag style).
Pour chella over, cook until set, fold and slide off; repeat.

recipes.name: Lugaimat
recipes.description: Crackly golden dumplings drenched in date syrup - the UAE's irresistible iftar siren.

steps.instruction: Beat flour, starch, yogurt, yeast and water into a thick batter; rise 1 hour.
Squeeze portions between thumb and fist; drop into 175°C oil.
Fry until deep amber, turning constantly for even spheres.
Drain 10 seconds, then plunge into warm date syrup; roll in sesame.
